xmldoc.short_description: XML document object returned by xmlread.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector: the XML content of the document.
a string: element name to search, or '*' for all elements.

param_output_item.param_description: an xmlElement object: the root element, or [] when the document has none.
an xmlNodeList object: matching elements in document order.
a character vector: all the text of the root element and its descendants, joined.

description.p: xmlDocument is the class of the object returned by xmlread. It can be passed to xmlwrite and xslt, and it gives a small read-only access to the content in the style of a DOM document.

The object keeps the XML content as text in its hidden property Text. The constructor stores text without checking it: a content that is not well-formed XML raises an error only when a method is called.

ul.li: getDocumentElement returns the root element as an xmlElement.
getElementsByTagName returns an xmlNodeList of all the elements with the given name, the root element included.
getTextContent returns the text of the whole document, without tags. As xmlread stores the document indented, this text can hold the line breaks and spaces found between elements.

description.p: The elements returned are copies of the content: they do not change the document, and the document cannot be modified through them.
